scope: Read-only source and local metadata review; no helper execution, remote calls, repository edits, or activation.

blocking_findings.finding: Symbolic HEAD is checked before acquiring index.lock but not inside it. A same-base branch switch before lock acquisition can pass the SHA guard and install the proposal branch index in a different checked-out branch.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Recheck symbolic-ref HEAD equals refs/heads/work/proposal-v5 inside index.lock before update-ref.

nonblocking_recommendations: Record failure phase and private backup path when an exception occurs after the first activation mutation; do not automatically roll back across concurrency.
After the append, verify the coordination file still starts with the captured original bytes.
accepted_scope: Private temporary index read-tree does not update working files.
Only manifest is replaced; source and unrelated dirty file bytes are checked and not rewritten.
Coordination uses append and has a private backup.
